items.title: Australians on US sub sat out operation to sink Iranian ship, PM says

items.title: 'You are liars, you are frauds': Hezbollah faces reckoning in Lebanon

items.title: Katherine faces flood emergency as river 'rising rapidly'

items.title: New Epstein files reveal an unconfirmed, alleged attempted sexual assault by Trump

items.title: Magistrate throws out AI seatbelt fine as driver appeals begin clogging courts

items.title: Getting an ADHD diagnosis may be easier, but will it make things better?
